items.teacher_evidence: Warm light-to-shadow face/neck planes use restrained warm shadows, small highlights, and selective navy contour against saturated print fields.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve literal source skin identity while translating relative light/shadow into restrained warm cel-shaded planes; never assign the teacher complexion.
exact_prompt_clauses: render skin as a coherent warm light-to-shadow cel-shaded plane with a restrained highlight band and selective deep-navy contour
Preserve the source's own skin identity rather than assigning any fixed person's colors
items.validation_probe: Frozen held-out person baseline with visible skin; record skin_treatment sub-loss and require it not to be masked by overall palette.

items.teacher_evidence: Hair is a dark ink mass separated by limited cool teal/cyan and warm coral accents, with tapered navy contour.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve source hair color, silhouette, and arrangement while applying relative dark mass grouping and limited cool/warm accents.
exact_prompt_clauses: group hair into its source-preserved silhouette as a dark ink mass with limited cool teal/cyan and warm coral rim or strand accents
controlled value blocks, and tapered navy contour
items.validation_probe: Frozen held-out person baseline with visible hair; record hair_treatment sub-loss independently.

items.teacher_evidence: Garments become interlocking dark, pale, teal, coral, and yellow print facets divided by clear ink seams with light grain.
items.source_preserving_rule: Preserve garment identity and markings while simplifying existing folds and values into limited palette planes, dark edge anchors, and subtle print texture.
exact_prompt_clauses: simplify clothing into source-preserved garment shapes and markings using a few interlocking value planes, dark seam/edge anchors, selective teal/coral/mustard harmonizing facets, and subtle print texture
Preserve the source's own garment identity rather than assigning any fixed outfit
items.validation_probe: Frozen held-out person baseline with visible clothing; record clothing_treatment sub-loss independently.

items.teacher_evidence: Visible lettering functions as a small high-contrast display accent with elegant thin strokes and supporting small type, integrated with print fields and sparse ornament.
items.source_preserving_rule: Render only caller-supplied exact text as a readable editorial display accent, preserve its spelling, and never add teacher wording, language, logos, or pseudo-text.
exact_prompt_clauses: If supplied, render exactly this verbatim text and no other readable or pseudo-readable text
Treat it as an opt-in editorial display accent: high-contrast light ink against a suitably dark or saturated support field, elegant handwritten/display-like stroke quality
Do not copy any external wording or language
items.validation_probe: Frozen held-out exact-text case; score typography_dialogue separately from spelling_adherence and fail any unrequested text or teacher-wording leakage.
